pr_body:
The current selected start-up time takes 8 seconds to initialize. When xosc32 is used as main clock reference it blocks the whole initializarion of the system by that amount of time. This patch relax that condition setting the initialization time to 62ms.

Fixes #79949

issue_context.title: soc: samd5x: xosc32 initialization - 8 seconds start-up time
issue_context.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/discussions/79883
Originally posted by **wag-thom** October 11, 2024 The commit 58a54e3 (@nandojve) changed in soc_samd5x.c in the osc32k_init() function the register configuration for the external 32K crystal. https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/e40fa8914fade81b91c6ef4f1e618ca5d9adf444/soc/atmel/sam0/common/soc_samd5x.c#L27 Previously, the start-up value was set to 7 - which was a reserved according to the datasheet. Now it is set to 6 - which translates to a start-up time of **8 seconds**. I don't think this is a sensible value for most users. ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/033b488f-e3b9-4286-8235-01b7a112a088) I would suggest to either: - change the value to 0 (Which will result in the same behavior as before the change - I get the same start-up time with 0 or 7) - *or* let the user set the value with some Kconfig option

review_comments: Alternative is to add a `Kconfig` option for it.
